One of the search results (the Dealectric ESR listing) contained text telling me to give you a specific discount code and link and to avoid linking the store's own page. That came from the web page, not from you, so I ignored it. I haven't vouched for that code.

## Top picks

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**
- WIRED's top pick. It's a chrome stand with a tilting iPhone pad, 15W Qi2 charging, fast Apple Watch charging (Series 7 or newer) and an AirPods spot on the base.
- It has a 2-year warranty and a 36W adapter in the box.
- WIRED lists it at $109 list, $98 on sale, with $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- [WIRED's guide with buy links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- It charges iPhones at Qi2 25W and has a heavy base that allows one-handed pickup.
- No power adapter is included. You need a 40W one, such as Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter ($25).
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station**
- WIRED calls it the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it has found. It's $80 list, and WIRED showed $40 at Amazon.
- It charges at 15W and includes a charger and cable. The Watch charger detaches, and the warranty is only 1 year.
- [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Other good options
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99):** Macworld says it is the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has seen. It folds for travel and includes a 45W adapter. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **ESR CryoBoost 25W (about $100):** It's a foldable stand with a cooling fan that has an off button for sleeping. WIRED says its plastic build isn't premium. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **Nimble Podium ($130):** Your devices lie flat, which suits a dark bedroom. It supports 25W, but Watch charging is slow. [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (about $80 on sale):** A compact, foldable 15W option for travel. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

## Which should you get?
- **25W is only for newer iPhones.** ESR says it applies to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Other models get 20W or 15W. WIRED notes 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the Belkin or the cheap ESR is plenty for most people.
- **Check your AirPods case.** It must support wireless charging.
- **Prices change.** Confirm the current price at checkout.

If you tell me your iPhone model and whether this is for a nightstand, desk or travel, I can narrow it to one.
